test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 July 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is **Barely.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• “ Barely” means “almost not”.
 
• The complete sentence will be, “**Anthony Abraham, a 34-year-old crane driver, (1) barely managed to get out of the way of falling steel**.”

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• “**Substantially**” means **to a significant extent**.

 
 
• **Example-** *The rate of women’s education in India has grown substantially over the years*.
 
 
 
• **“Simultaneously”** means "**at the same time**”.
 
 
• **Example**- *He was cooking and talking over his phone simultaneously.*
 
 
 
• **“Rarely”** means “**seldom**.”
 
 
• **Example**- *He rarely misses class.*
